arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# FY1981 Net budget outlays (millions of nominal dollars)
outlays = [59099, 53969, 54216, 57198, 54608, 55619, 58486, 53095, 53698, 64216, 56838, 76875]

# Calculate population standard deviation
n = len(outlays)
mean = sum(outlays) / n
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in outlays) / n
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)

print(f"Mean: {mean}")
print(f"Variance: {variance}")
print(f"Population Standard Deviation: {pop_std}")
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {round(pop_std, 2)}")
EOF
